Vgl. Gl Geistliche 17, wo diese Gleichstellung an den Zölibat geknüpft wird; vgl. Geþyncðo 7². Den Eideswert von Priester und Thegn stellt ohne diese Bedingung gleich Að 2
Cf. Gl Geistliche 17, where this equal ranking is tied to celibacy; cf. Geþyncðo 7². Að 2 equates the oath-value of priest and thegn without this condition
Nicht 2000 Thrymsen, sondern Sceat (s. d. Gl 2d) sind Wergeld des Kenters; gegen Thorpe Dipl. 471
The wergild of the Kentishman is 2000 sceattas (see that word in Gl 2d), not thrymsas; against Thorpe Dipl. 471

note.label: mass-thegn
note.seg: i.e. a priest in full orders; cf. mæssepreost

note.label: thrymsas
note.seg: If a thryms is equal to three pence, 2,000 would give the thegn a 1,200 shilling wergild, reckoning 5 pence to the shilling, as in Wessex; yet in the next chapter 266 thrymsas gives the ceorl a 200 (actually 199½) shilling wergild only if 4 pence are reckoned to the shilling. Thus the normal relationship of 1:6 between the wergilds of ceorl and thegn is upset.
